thread:
maria: Observability alert — canary 2026-03 is seeing KV miss storms and error spikes, 5xxs up in the last minute. Rolling back? :warning:
ton y: I see the console traffic split at 10% to the canary. Do we want a full panic switch or a safe disable (drain + TTL sweep)?
elaine: If we panic-switch we stop traffic instantly but KV could have stale entries on old routing. Need to evict prefix caches.
maria: Good point. What does the fast revert playbook recommend for prefetch + KV?
kevin: Playbook: panic switch -> set canary traffic to 0 -> trigger prefix eviction -> flush short-lived prefetch queues -> monitor error-rate. But we should also flip routing policy to fallback-model to avoid incompatible variants.
maria: Ok can someone run the panic action in the console? I don't want to type curl if there's a button.
elaine: I'll hit the panic button in Console. Before I do, add telemetry tag so the rollback shows up in dashboards (tag=panic-switch:canary-2026-03).
kevin: Also throttle ingress for canary route (rate-limit 50rps) so the drain isn't a flood when we shift traffic back.
tony: FYI here's the CLI incantation if anyone needs it:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/rollouts/2026-03/actions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"panic_revert","traffic":0,"evict_prefix":"/kv/canary/"}'
```
maria: Elaine — please confirm once the console action is clicked. I'll watch dashboards.
elaine: clicked. Console shows: canary traffic -> 10% -> 0% ; rollout state = PAUSED ; actionId=act_789
deploy-bot: [act_789] rollback initiated by elaine — traffic set to 0.
sre-bot: Detected eviction job queued: kv-sweep job id sweep_432. ETA ~15s.
kevin: Running a manual sweep on metadata nodes too: `redis-cli --cluster call sweep_432 EVICT /kv/canary/*` (one-off)
tony: After eviction, we should bump KV TTLs back to normal. During canary we had TTL=60s for aggressive prefetch; restore to 300s to avoid storm.
maria: Noted. Also re-enable fallbacks on router to model-v1 (safe default).
elaine: sweep finished, errors are dropping. Dashboard shows 5xx down from 3.2% -> 0.7% in last 30s. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'm going to run the post-mortem checklist: annotate the rollout in the console with the root cause hypothesis (incompatible tokenization + cache key mismatch) and attach perf traces.
maria: Good. For follow-up: add a preflight check that verifies KV keyspace compatibility before a canary flip, and a console interlock that warns if TTL overrides exist.
tony: Also propose a UI change: expose a one-click "evict keys for canary" checkbox on the panic modal so rollback is atomic.
elaine: Filing a small RFC for the UI change and a quick infra ticket to add the preflight hook.
maria: Thanks all. Closing the thread once PMs ack.
kevin: I'll drop a short runbook update in docs repo.
ony: typo — meant to say @tony above.
maria: haha noted. Reopen if anything pops back up.
